name: Flamco Flexcontrol 1"
description:
This isolating union connects the expansion vessel to the central heating system and enables verification of the vessel’s gas charge or, alternatively, allows you to replace it without draining the entire system.

Saves a considerable amount of time when servicing a Flexcon vessel.
Enables you to check the pre-charge pressure without having to disconnect the vessel.
Enables you to change the vessel or check the pre-charge pressure without having to release the system pressure or drain the system.
With integrated ball valve and hose connection.
Flexcontrol ¾" F / 1" F: With swivel nut connection for easy mounting of the expansion vessel.
Connection:
A - Rp 1"
B - G 1" F

name: Flamco Flexfast Quick Isolation Connector
description:
The insulating connection makes it possible to quickly and effortlessly check whether the Flexcon expansion tank is working properly (gas pressure) or needs to be replaced.

Easy to assemble with the right tools; Then screw the components with your hand.
Allows you to change the tank without releasing and draining the pressure.
Significantly saves time when caring for the Flexcon tank.
Connection:
A - R 3/4"
B - G 3/4" F
